hostMode.description: Where a member's repos live. polyfill: the AppView hosts them because the member's PDS cannot. migrating: the client is copying them to the PDS, and the AppView stays authoritative until each copy verifies. native: the PDS hosts them and the AppView syncs from it.

uri.description: The record's URI, the same one it keeps after a migration.

cid.description: The CID of the record or blob.

recordView.description: A record in a repo the AppView hosts.

cid.description: The CID of the record or blob.

migrationRecord.description: A record to replay on the user's PDS during a migration.

spacesTotal.description: How many spaces hold a repo that has to move.

spacesDone.description: How many of those repos have verified on the PDS.

migrationProgress.description: How far a migration has come.
